q_ko: Dupixent는 호산구성 식도염(EoE)에 대해 FDA 승인을 언제 받았고, 소아 적응증 확대는 언제였나?
q_en: When did the FDA approve Dupixent for eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), and when was the pediatric indication expanded?
answer: FDA approved Dupixent for EoE in patients aged 12+ on May 20, 2022 (first and only medicine indicated for EoE in the US). Pediatric expansion (age 1+, ≥15 kg) approved by FDA in January 2024; EU pediatric approval November 2024. EU adult/adolescent approval January 30, 2023.
notes: Dates embedded in narrative paragraphs.

q_ko: Sanofi가 2025년 12월 19일 미국 정부와 체결한 MFN(최혜국) 가격 합의의 주요 내용은?
q_en: What are the main terms of the voluntary MFN pricing agreement Sanofi signed with the US government on December 19, 2025?
answer: Align Medicaid prices on certain wholly owned medicines with other high-income countries; cut prices by 61% for select diabetes, cardiovascular, neurological and cancer drugs; offer ~70% discounts via the TrumpRx DTC platform (e.g. Plavix from $756 to $16); extend the $35 monthly insulin cap to all US patients from January 1, 2026. In return: tariff exemptions.
notes: 20-F Item 4 US pricing environment narrative.

q_ko: 2025년 12월 1일 체결된 영국-미국 제약 협정(UK-US deal)의 내용은?
q_en: What did the UK-US pharmaceutical deal signed on December 1, 2025 include?
answer: Caps future UK clawback at around 15%, raises NICE's cost-effectiveness threshold to £25k-£35k per QALY, and commits to increasing the budget for innovative drugs to 0.6% of GDP by 2035.
notes: 20-F Europe pricing narrative.
